analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일간 RSI 38.3 → 49.6 → 45 → 45.5로 중립 구간에서 횡보하며 방향성 부재. MACD 히스토그램은 개선되고 있으나 여전히 음수이며, 5일 평균 거래량 대비 비율 0.34로 거래량 동반 없는 움직임은 신뢰도가 낮음. 52주 위치 11.3%로 저점 부근이나, 5일/20일 고가/저가 패턴 모두 뚜렷한 방향성을 보이지 않아 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI has been sideways in the neutral zone from 38.3 → 49.6 → 45 → 45.5 over the last 3 trading days, showing no clear direction. MACD histogram is improving but still negative, and the volume ratio (0.34 vs 5-day average) indicates weak conviction. Despite being near the 52-week low (11.3% position), the 5-day/20-day price patterns lack clear direction, warranting a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($72.06) vs SMA5/20/50($70.77/$72.57/$77.76) — Below SMA20, indicating short-term weakness.
· Significantly below SMA100/200($86.11/$91.79) — Suggests a weak medium to long-term trend.
· 52-week position (11.3%) — Trading near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (32.3→45.5) — Exited oversold territory and entered neutral zone, weak upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.2681→0.4261) — Attempting to bottom out, not yet a bearish reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid $72.57) — Sideways movement around the middle band, lacking direction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($70.86) — Support based on Pivot (PP $71.86) and SMA5 ($70.77).
· Swing Resistance ($72.53) — Close to SMA20 ($72.57), acting as short-term resistance.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways) — No trend reversal signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.34x) — Movement lacks conviction due to low volume, reducing reliability.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) — Sideways pattern continues, maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to lack of clear direction.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 고가/저가: $73.76 / $67.67, 20일 고가/저가: $78.44 / $65.08로, 5일간의 변동폭이 20일 변동폭보다 좁아 횡보 국면 지속.
analysis.patternNoteEn: 5-day High/Low: $73.76 / $67.67, 20-day High/Low: $78.44 / $65.08, indicating a continuation of the sideways phase as the 5-day range is narrower than the 20-day range.
keyPoints: RSI가 과매도 구간을 탈출했으나 여전히 중립 구간에 머물러 있어 상승 동력이 약함.
MACD 히스토그램은 개선되고 있으나, 음수 구간에서 벗어나지 못해 추세 전환을 확신하기 어려움.
거래량 비율이 0.34로 낮아 현재 가격 움직임의 신뢰도가 떨어짐.
keyPointsEn: RSI has exited oversold but remains in neutral territory, indicating weak upward momentum.
MACD histogram is improving but has not yet crossed into positive territory, making a trend reversal uncertain.
The low volume ratio of 0.34 suggests low conviction behind the current price movement.
analysis.riskNote: ADX가 30.4로 뚜렷한 추세를 나타내지만, -DI(27.9)가 +DI(23.4)보다 높아 하락 압력이 우위에 있어 추세 전환 가능성을 경계해야 함.
analysis.riskNoteEn: While ADX at 30.4 indicates a clear trend, the higher -DI (27.9) compared to +DI (23.4) suggests downward pressure, warranting caution for trend reversal.
analysis.continuity: 4일 연속 관망 유지. 직전 판단과 동일하게 RSI 중립, MACD 악화 지속, 횡보 패턴이 이어지고 있으며, 거래량 부재로 인해 방향 전환 신호가 명확하지 않음.
